report.statement: Approved: this exact plan is approved for production handoff.

feasibility.label: Puzzle count
feasibility.detail: Within the project cap of 20 puzzles.

feasibility.label: Word banks
feasibility.detail: Each theme pool can become one word bank.

feasibility.label: Difficulty profiles
feasibility.detail: Each level can become one difficulty profile.

feasibility.label: Generator settings
feasibility.detail: Level grids, directions and word counts are within the generator's limits.

feasibility.label: Print profile
feasibility.detail: 8.5 x 11 in paperback interior, black ink on white paper, no bleed

feasibility.label: Puzzle grids on the page
feasibility.detail: Each level's grid fits the live area at 9 pt or more before the title and word list are laid out. The interior layout decides with the real word list.

feasibility.label: Solution grids
feasibility.detail: Each level's solution fits 1 a page at 7 pt or more before captions.

feasibility.label: Words fit their grids
feasibility.detail: All 48 assigned words fit their level's grid in an enabled direction.

feasibility.label: Page count
feasibility.detail: About 28-30 logical pages from the plan. The exact count comes from the publication plan; the renderer never pads.

feasibility.label: Puzzle generation
feasibility.detail: Whether every grid places all its words is known only when production generates and verifies each puzzle. Placement is bounded and may fail for dense grids.

feasibility.label: Cover
feasibility.detail: Cover size and spine derive from the built interior's real page count and paper; they cannot be planned exactly.
